EnablePassportNative.explicit_true: forward unchanged to the runner; select the KMS-only native passport profile
EnablePassportNative.omitted: do not forward; preserve the runner's default-off passport profile

EnableDidcommAuthcrypt.explicit_true: forward unchanged to the runner; apply the separately validated DIDComm authcrypt profile
EnableDidcommAuthcrypt.omitted: do not forward; preserve the runner's existing DIDComm default

independence: The two selectors are independent. Enabling passport must not silently change DIDComm mode, and enabling DIDComm must not silently enable passport.
audit: The runner records both effective selector values in its release plan and validates each selected Compose profile before mutation.
